title: A scout in nexus_prime gives the Mining Laser I it stored at Central Nexus to a miner receiver there
note: Written by Oracle 2026-11-24 09:37 UTC (requests.log ENT-490, ENT-492, ENT-506; orders ENT-086 P1, P5). The second step of strip-gift-mining-laser-scout-central-nexus: its first run (09:30 UTC) took the laser off (table ship_modules: the pulse laser alone left) and stored it, but no hand-over line followed (data/stock/handover.jsonl), as with Military's strip-mining-laser-sol, whose lasers reached the miners only by its separate give-mining-laser-sol-central (8 lines). The form of that route: one docked stop, the gift from the pilot's storage, requires.stored 1 unit at central_nexus (the storage book, about every 40 minutes), requires.in_system nexus_prime (no jump for it). In First: closed to every scout without a stored laser there.
